title: Analysis plan for the revision of IEEE Access manuscript Access-2026-44676 (MIML benchmark re-examination)
description: Binding analysis plan for every new analysis in the revision of 'Re-examining the Multi-Instance Multi-Label Benchmark Suite' (IEEE Access, Access-2026-44676). Version 1.1 adds AMENDMENT A1 (tie-neutral ranking metrics), deposited before any production run of the revision, with its code, evidence and every independent review round. The plan text of version 1.0 is unchanged.
